Name: Stardew Kite Soar
Author: tangsuanz
Description:
Update 20261003
这是一个超大更新，现在它不是时尚感的组件了，而是一个独立mod

在罗宾的木匠铺买一只风筝，把它装到风筝线轴上（像鱼竿装鱼饵一样），然后手持线轴左键放飞！
跑得越快，风筝升得越高——上升速度按你的实际移动速度线性换算，没有上限：走路时慢慢升，跑步时正常升，骑马飞奔时它一冲上天。停下来风筝会缓缓降落，降到悬停高度就随风轻摆，不会落地消失。

[b]玩法[/b]
[list]
[*]两种风筝：普通风筝（250g）和鹞子风筝（1000g，更吃风、升得更快）[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]风筝线轴（500g）：拿起风筝右键线轴即可装上，随时可取下[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]手持线轴左键放飞 / 收线（带确认窗），放飞中右键强制收回[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]升降完全由移动速度驱动，顶墙「干跑」不算速度[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]到顶锁定、悬停高度等行为都可在设置里调[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/20574/20574-1791039518-1462996190.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/20574/20574-1791039523-1034587049.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/20574/20574-1791039531-46565693.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/20574/20574-1791039538-1195732424.png[/img]




[b]配置[/b]：支持 Generic Mod Config Menu，售价、上升速度、最大高度、悬停高度、拖尾距离、风力抖动等全部可调

[b]安装[/b]
[list=1]
[*]先装 SMAPI 和 Content Patcher[/*]
[*]解压后将 KiteSoar  文件夹放入 Mods[/*]
[*]进游戏到罗宾处购买即可[/*]
[/list]

This is a massive update, now it is no longer a content pack for fashion sense but an independent mod
Buy a kite at Robin's carpenter shop, attach it to a Kite Spool (just like attaching bait to a fishing rod), then hold the spool and left-click to fly!
The faster you move, the higher your kite climbs — climb speed scales linearly with your actual movement speed with no cap: strolling lifts it gently, running at full speed is the baseline, and galloping on a horse sends it soaring. Stand still and it drifts back down, hovering at a configurable height instead of hitting the ground.

[b]Configuration[/b]: Full Generic Mod Config Menu support — prices, climb speed, max height, hover height, trailing distance, wind bob and more are all adjustable. 

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first[/*]
[*]Extract and drop the KiteSoar folder into your Mods folder[/*]
[*]In game, visit Robin's shop to buy your first kite[/*]
[/list]

Update 20240318
20240318 更新
添加了一个鹞子风筝
Added a traditional Chinese kite called 'yaozi'.

我老婆想要在星露谷放风筝，于是有了这个mod。目前还很不完善，使用时尚感的配件制作，后续可能会增加其他功能。
My wife wanted to fly kites in Stardew Valley, so this mod came into being. It's currently far from perfect, made for Fashion Sense as accessories, and I might add more features when I have time.


其实这是一个时尚感的内容包，首先安装时尚感，然后去皮埃尔的种子店购买手镜，拿着手镜单击，在打开的页面中调整配件为风筝
It's actually a Fashion Sense content pack, belonging to the accessory type. You need to install the Fashion Sense mod, then purchase a hand mirror at Pierre's Seed Shop. After selecting it, click the left mouse button, and then change the accessory to a kite.
